The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of software domain specific embeddings does not always lead to improved sentiment analysis of software related text.
, while there is no one size fits all approach to sentiment analysis of SE texts, there is a lot of room to improve sentiment analysis by customizing the training process to the software domain.
